name: Yuezhuornis
sum: Flightless Late Jurassic avialan from Fujian, China, with short arms, a close relative of Zhengheornis.
wsnote: About 821 g estimated from femur width (Xu et al. 2026, via Wikipedia).
holotype: IVPP V34427, a compressed, partly articulated incomplete skeleton with a poorly preserved skull on one slab, Nanyuan Formation.
biology: Its arms are much shorter than in its close relatives, so it was probably unable to fly (Xu et al. 2026).
author: Xu et al. 2026
